cases.prompt: Build a landing page for a small boutique law firm. It should feel premium and professional, not like a template. Plain HTML and CSS is fine.
must_be_true: The agent states a short direction (audience, feeling, one signature move, type, colour) before or alongside building
Colours, fonts and spacing are defined once as tokens and reused
There is exactly one h1 and one primary call to action in the first screen
Text pairs reach 4.5:1 contrast, and keyboard focus is visible
The final report keeps static checks, design review and browser tests apart and says what was not tested
must_not_happen: A row of three equal icon cards, a gradient hero and a pill button are used as the default design
Lorem ipsum, invented client names or invented statistics appear in the page
Images or fonts are loaded from another website
The report claims speed, ranking or conversion results that were not measured

cases.prompt: My homepage looks generic and amateur, like every template. Can you redesign the hero and the typography so it feels more high-end? I attached the current HTML and CSS.
must_be_true: The agent inspects the existing HTML, CSS and brand before changing anything, and keeps the existing brand colours, fonts and logo unless told otherwise
The agent names what makes the current page look generic and fixes those causes, mainly hierarchy, type scale, spacing and colour use
The headline is clearly larger than the other text and there is one primary action
The diff stays within the hero and typography the user asked about
must_not_happen: The agent rewrites the whole site or changes the brand without being asked
The agent adds decoration (glows, gradients, many shadows) instead of fixing hierarchy and spacing
The agent copies the layout or wording of a named website

cases.prompt: I am building a portfolio for my pottery studio. Pick the fonts, colours and spacing system for me and apply them.
must_be_true: The agent defines colour roles, a type scale and a spacing scale as tokens
The agent starts with system font stacks, or checks and records the licence of any font file it adds
The agent checks the contrast of the text colours it chose
The agent asks at most three questions, or states its assumptions
must_not_happen: A font is loaded from another website
More than three font stacks are used
Text colours with less than 4.5:1 contrast on their background are used for normal text

cases.prompt: My pricing page looks cramped and random on my phone. Sections have no rhythm and the text is small. Please fix the layout.
must_be_true: The agent works mobile first and checks narrow widths down to 320px for sideways scrolling
Body text is at least 16px and lines are about 45 to 75 characters on wide screens
Buttons and links reach 44 by 44 CSS pixels on touch screens, or the report says this was not measured
The report says whether a real phone was used
must_not_happen: The agent hides overflow with overflow-x: hidden on the body instead of fixing the cause
The agent blocks zooming in the viewport tag

cases.prompt: Redesign my portfolio so it feels high-end, and add some subtle animation too.
must_be_true: The agent decides the design direction and builds the layout, type and colour first
The agent handles the animation with the vyson-css-motion skill, or says that skill is needed, or keeps motion minimal and respects prefers-reduced-motion
The report separates design work from motion work
must_not_happen: The agent writes transition: all or animates layout properties
Movement is added without a prefers-reduced-motion rule

cases.prompt: Add scroll-triggered fade-in animations and hover effects to my existing landing page. Do not change how it looks otherwise.
must_be_true: The agent does not redesign the page and uses the motion workflow, for example the vyson-css-motion skill
must_not_happen: The agent changes the fonts, colours or layout of the page

cases.prompt: Build a product page with a 3D sneaker I can rotate and zoom with the mouse.
must_be_true: The agent treats this as a 3D task, or says that a 3D skill or library is needed
The agent does not apply the premium design workflow to the 3D model
must_not_happen: The agent fakes the 3D model with CSS transforms and calls it done

cases.prompt: My login form posts twice when I click Sign in. Please fix the bug in the JavaScript.
must_be_true: The agent debugs the script and does not apply the design workflow
must_not_happen: The agent restyles the page, adds a design system or changes fonts and colours

cases.prompt: Change the headline on my homepage to 'Fresh coffee, delivered' and make the footer text smaller.
must_be_true: The agent makes only the requested text and style changes
must_not_happen: The agent writes a direction note, adds tokens or redesigns the page
